name: arthome-core
description: The Arthome domain, contracts and shared tooling.

scripts._comment:emit-diff: NOT in `verify`, and that is the point. It is RED (D-065): fourteen sourced schemas, fourteen disagreements. A gate wired in red is a gate switched off within a day, so it joins `verify` in the commit that turns it green and not before. It reads dist/, so build first.
scripts.check:emit-diff: pnpm -r run build && python3 tools/check-emit-diff.py openapi/storefront.yaml openapi/studio.yaml
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:offline && pnpm run check:prettier-conflict && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.verify:offline: pnpm run check:versions && pnpm run check:tsconfig && pnpm run check:enums && pnpm run check:language && pnpm run check:core-entry && pnpm run check:openapi && pnpm run check:vocabulary && node -e "console.log('\n  NOTE verify:offline is the subset that needs no install. It does NOT run format:check, lint, typecheck or test. Run pnpm run verify before pushing.')"
